# Provider directory source

Provider names, URLs, and directory metadata were adapted from the MIT-licensed decolua/9router registry at commit 17c4cc76877bd1755030a8414f8d0083f48dcccf (2026-09-18). See 9router-LICENSE.txt.

Native adapters are implemented in this repository. Subscription, cookie, and specialized service entries use an independently operated private 9router connection, not a shared global subscription account. Directory presence does not assert that a live provider credential has been tested.
